title: feat(find-workspace-dir): add env var support for setting the workspace dir
body: PNPM has support for passing in the lockfile dir override via `NPM_CONFIG_LOCKFILE_DIR`, however the workspace dir is only calculated by traversing up the folder structure from the working dir in search of a `pnpm-workspace.yaml` file. This change lets `NPM_CONFIG_WORKSPACE_DIR` work in a similar manner by overriding (and avoiding the traversal if possible).
